primary_source.citation: Mudie DM, Amidon GL, Amidon GE. Physiological parameters for oral delivery and in vitro testing. Mol Pharm. 2010;7(5):1388-405.
primary_source.extraction_method: Extracted programmatically from the PMC JATS XML (efetch db=pmc id=3025274) on 2026-10-12. Values were read out of the published tables rather than transcribed by hand from a PDF.
primary_source.license_note: The PMC copy states it is available for text mining and fair use. SYNTHBODY reproduces individual physiological measurements (facts) with full attribution; no text or table layout is reproduced.

small_intestine_geometry.citation: US EPA httk package, physiology.data (Small Intestine Radius, Small Intestine Mean Residence Time).
small_intestine_geometry.note: httk gives a human small-intestinal mean residence time of 199.2 min, which independently corroborates the 192 min fasted transit mean reported by Mudie et al. The two were obtained from unrelated sources.

model_structure.citation: Yu LX, Amidon GL. A compartmental absorption and transit model for estimating oral drug absorption. Int J Pharm. 1999;186(2):119-25.
model_structure.note: SYNTHBODY implements the CAT structure (N transit compartments in series with a single transit rate constant) as described in the widely reproduced literature. The primary paper is paywalled and was NOT retrieved; no numerical values were taken from it. Only the structural convention N = 7 is adopted.

provenance.honest_caveat: Fasted-state parameters only. The fed state is NOT implemented: Mudie et al. report fed values with far greater spread and strong dependence on meal volume and caloric load, and SYNTHBODY has no food-effect model. Any simulation here represents a fasted subject given the dose with water.

ph.basis: Median fasted gastric pH, Mudie et al. Table 3. Reported medians 1.7, 1.8; mean 2.9 +- 1.97; range 1.0-2.5.

volume_mL.basis: Mudie et al. report a basal fasted gastric volume of ~28 mL and ~296 mL after 300 mL of water. SYNTHBODY assumes the dose is taken with a glass of water and uses 250 mL. This is a dosing-condition assumption, not a measurement.

half_emptying_time_min.basis: Fasted gastric half-emptying time with 300 mL water, Mudie et al. Table 6. Range 11.5-17.0 min. A value of 12 min is reported for saline.

n_compartments.basis: The CAT model convention of seven transit compartments in series (Yu & Amidon 1999). A structural choice, not a measurement.

total_transit_time_min.basis: Mean fasted small-intestinal transit time for coated pellets, Mudie et al. Table 6. Range 90-324 min. Independently corroborated by the httk value of 199.2 min.

total_volume_mL.basis: Mean total fasted small-intestinal liquid volume by MRI, Mudie et al. Table 4 (105 +- 72 mL; median 83 mL; range 45-319 mL).

length_cm.basis: Mean anatomical small-intestinal length, Mudie et al. Table 4. Range 255-1128 cm.

radius_cm.basis: Human small-intestinal radius from the US EPA httk physiology dataset.

ph_profile.basis: Mudie et al. Table 3 give fasted median pH of 6.1-6.2 (duodenum), ~6.8-7.1 (jejunum, means) and 7.2 (ileum, median). SYNTHBODY interpolates monotonically across the seven compartments between the measured duodenal and ileal endpoints. The endpoints are measured; the interpolation between them is a modelling choice.

bile_salt_mM.basis: Mudie et al. Table 2 give fasted median bile-salt concentrations of 2.7 mM (duodenum), 2.6 mM (jejunum) and a mean of 2 +- 0.2 mM (ileum). The declining profile across compartments is interpolated between those measured points.

ph.basis: SYNTHBODY default. Mudie et al. do not tabulate colonic pH. Colonic absorption is modelled only as a small residual term and this value should not be relied upon.

volume_mL.basis: SYNTHBODY default, not from a retrieved source.

transit_time_min.basis: SYNTHBODY default (~15 h). Not from a retrieved source. Colonic transit is highly variable.

relative_permeability_factor.basis: Colonic effective permeability is assumed to be one tenth of small-intestinal permeability, reflecting the much smaller absorptive surface area. This is a SYNTHBODY default and is NOT a measurement.

diffusion_layer_thickness_um.basis: Maximum hydrodynamic (Nernst) diffusion layer thickness in micrometres. The model uses h = min(particle radius, 30 um), a widely used convention. Mudie et al. Table 1 identify the diffusion layer as depending on fluid velocity, viscosity and particle size; SYNTHBODY does not compute it from hydrodynamics.

default_diffusion_coefficient_cm2_per_s.basis: Typical aqueous diffusion coefficient for a small organic molecule at body temperature. A SYNTHBODY default used only when the operator does not supply one.

drug_density_g_per_cm3.basis: Typical true density of an organic crystalline solid. A SYNTHBODY default.
